## Inline Code Comments
- Makefile:129: **issue:** Guard against missing CRD files so the glob pattern isn't treated as a literal filename

When `operators/$$op/config/crd/bases` has no `*.yaml` files, the inner loop runs once with the literal path `operators/$op/config/crd/bases/*.yaml`, creating a `*.yaml` file under `crds/`. Please add a guard (e.g., `if ls operators/$$op/config/crd/bases/*.yaml >/dev/null 2>&1; then` before the loop, or `[ -f "$$crd" ] || continue` inside it) to avoid this behavior when no CRDs exist for an operator.
- operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/service.yaml:16: **suggestion (bug_risk):** Gate the webhook Service port behind the same `.Values.webhook.enabled` flag as the webhook configuration

Right now the `Service` always exposes 443 → 9443, but the Deployment only defines the 9443 container port (and the webhook configurations) when `.Values.webhook.enabled` is true. With `webhook.enabled` false, the Service targets a non-existent container port. Please wrap the webhook port (or the whole Service) in the same conditional to keep them consistent.
